audit_items.proof_trace: The property asserts tokenAmount = investedCapital * rate / 1e18, but the code correctly uses askTokenTotalSupply * cachedTokenAllocationRate / 1e18 (TOKEN_ALLOCATION_RATE_DENOMINATOR = 1e18). This is intentional design: cachedTokenAllocationRate is an investor's fractional share of the total token supply, not a price-per-capital conversion factor. The merge/transfer path (L852) adds rates together, which is only arithmetically correct under the share-of-supply model — adding rates under an investedCapital*rate formula would give (capA+capB)*(rateA+rateB)/1e18 ≠ capA*rateA/1e18 + capB*rateB/1e18.
